answer_2.quote: We evaluate the overall accuracy at the sentence level for all the sentences in our dataset. ... Coherence This metric aims to decouple the real-world and commonsense knowledge of the model from the understanding of negative sentences. We compute two coherence scores ...

answer_4.quote: Two native speakers of English were required to assess a randomly selected sample of 220 sentences from our dataset. Evaluators were required to answer four questions for each sentence: i) Is the sentence true or false?, ii) is the sentence grammatically correct?, iii) is the sentence understandable? and iv) is the sentence plausible and might be produced by a speaker?
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators answered four questions per sentence: truthfulness, grammaticality, understandability, and plausibility.
